_meta.description: Swiss employee social-insurance contribution parameters for salary year 2026. Rates are federal and uniform across cantons. See per-value 'source' fields for the authoritative citation of each figure.
_meta.notes: Employee shares only. AHV/IV/EO and ALV rates unchanged for 2026 despite the 13th AHV pension (financed via VAT, not wage contributions). BVG limits are adjusted biennially; the 2025 values remain in force for 2026.

ahvIvEo.note: Total 10.6% split 50/50; employee pays 5.3% of gross with no upper limit.

alv.note: 2.2% split 50/50; employee 1.1% up to CHF 148'200/year. No contribution above the ceiling since the Solidaritätsprozent was abolished on 01.01.2023.

nbu.note: Non-occupational accident insurance (UVG). The premium is set per employer/insurer and paid by the employee; the insured-earnings ceiling equals CHF 148'200/year. The default here (1.4%) is a typical illustrative value and is user-adjustable — it is not an official uniform rate.

bvg.note: Mandatory (obligatorisch) BVG only. Retirement credits (Altersgutschriften) per Art. 16 BVG apply from age 25 on the coordinated salary. Employee share is the legal minimum of 50%; many plans and super-mandatory (überobligatorisch) coverage differ, so real deductions can be higher.
